title: Weakly supervised deep learning predicts perineural invasion in tongue cancer slides
summary: Using 1,511 H&E whole-slide images from 629 patients at two centers, a ResNet50 feature extractor with multiple-instance aggregation and a Transformer fusion model predicted perineural invasion. AUCs were 0.968 internally and 0.940 in an external cohort of 192 patients. The study is retrospective, and workflow effects need prospective evaluation.
ai_technology: ResNet50 patch model with multiple-instance learning and a cross-attention Transformer on whole-slide images
organization: Central South University; Xiangya Hospital, Central South University

evidence.tested: Performance was assessed in an internal validation cohort and an external test cohort.
evidence.unknown: Clinical utility and prospective performance are untested. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A weakly supervised pipeline predicted PNI from slide images without region annotation.
